Name: CP Alex and Sebastian Fix
Author: TrentXV
Description:
Have you ever wondered why Alex working out in his room is shirtless but when you married to him and his sprit is working out shirtless but when you talk to him it isn't? Or where are Sebastian's tools when he is fixing his bike once he is fixing the bike after marrying him?

This mods changes the portraits to the ones used in the cutscenes to display a more accurate version of the situation.

It is compatible with custom portraits or sprites, it is not compatible with mods that will change their married dialogue though.

Manifest.Name: Alex and Sebastian Fix
Manifest.Description: Fix Alex and Sebastian Portraits once you married and they are shirtless
